谁藏在树叶和树枝里？: Who is hiding among the leaves?
找找竹节虫、叶䗛和蛾。点一点你发现的位置，再换成素色背景，看它们还藏得住吗。: Find the stick insect, leaf insect and moth. Tap where you spot one, then try a plain background to see how well they hide.
换背景时仔细看：改变的是动物，还是动物周围的环境？: Watch when the background changes: did the animals change, or did their surroundings change?
原创示意插画用于比较背景匹配和形态拟态，不用于物种识别。竹节虫与叶䗛的形态特点参: Original schematic illustrations compare background matching and resemblance to objects; they are not species-identification pictures. Stick and leaf insect traits follow Australian Museum descriptions; the moth is a generalized brown-pattern example. Animals cannot instantly choose a new body shape, and camouflage is not perfect invisibility. Observer, lighting, movement and background all affect detection.
先猜一猜，再动手试一试。: Make a guess, then try it.
细长的身体和褐色让竹节虫像一根树枝。除了颜色，身体的形状也在帮忙。: A long, brown body makes the stick insect resemble a twig. Shape helps, as well as color.
叶䗛的身体像一片叶子，还带着像叶脉的纹路。这样的拟态让它更难被发现。: The leaf insect has a leaf-shaped body with vein-like patterns. This resemblance makes it harder to spot.
这只蛾的褐色和斑纹与背景接近。颜色、花纹和背景一起影响它是否显眼。: This moth has brown colors and patterns similar to its surroundings. Color, pattern and background together affect how visible it is.
同样的颜色和形状，放到素色背景上就容易看见。伪装有没有用，要看周围是什么样。: The same colors and shapes are easier to see against a plain background. How well camouflage works depends on the surroundings.
慢慢找，不用比赛。留意树枝上的细腿、叶子边的触角，还有展开的翅膀。: Take your time; it is not a race. Look for thin legs on twigs, antennae beside leaves, and spread wings.
点点三个圈，认识它们各自的藏身办法。它们没有真的变成树枝或树叶。: Tap the three circles to explore how each animal hides. They have not actually turned into twigs or leaves.
